name: High-voltage circuit breakers (132-500 kV)
description: SF6 dead-tank and live-tank circuit breakers at 132, 275 and 500 kV for grid and substation duty, with interrupting ratings set by the Malaysian fault levels, to IEC 62271-100.

specifications.basis: TNB 500 kV fault rating 50 kA for 1 s, so breakers are specified at or above it
TNB 275 kV 40 kA for 3 s, 50 kA near power stations
TNB 132 kV 31.5 kA for 3 s, 40 kA near power stations

Western/Japanese brand new dead-tank at 145 kV roughly USD 40,000-95,000 (a Siemens SPS-145 used unit listed near USD 95,000; a Spanish tender for 145 kV 3150 A 31.5 kA at about EUR 26,000); Chinese OEMs quote far lower, USD 2,500-45,000. Export price list basis (accepted on owner instruction 2026-11-13).

source.note: market listings and tender records cited from search summary, 2026-11-13

specifications.basis: A municipal utility PO for a Siemens SP2-245 at USD 85,650/unit; Chinese OEM 252 kV units USD 60,000-93,000. Export price list basis (accepted on owner instruction 2026-11-13).

source.note: procurement record cited from search summary, 2026-11-13

specifications.basis: Chinese OEM 550 kV about USD 210,000-270,000; an import record of a 3150 A 50 kA three-phase set near USD 520,000; EGAT tender about THB 6.0 million per unit (about USD 170,000). Indicative and highly configuration-dependent.
